name: simple-hack
description: Organise, join, judge and publish a hosted hackathon with Simple Hack skills.

interface.longDescription:
Plan and run a free hackathon on simple-hack.app with five role-focused skills. Organisers create an event, set registration, content, tracks and judging, manage teams, and publish results. Participants join with a code, form teams, choose a track, submit an entry and vote. Judges open project sites, score the rubric and manage conflicts. Website Deploy Builder helps plan a team project, and Website Deploy helps publish its static site and declared saved data.

If the Simple Hack connector is available, the skills use its tools with the signed-in person's event permissions. Otherwise they guide the same actions through the REST API using the person's simple-hack.app key. The same connection works across event roles and can select the person's current team for site publishing. An optional reference covers a private self-hosted event.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a draft hackathon for our student club in November
Show my hackathon events and the stage of each one
I am judging a hackathon; show my projects and scoring rubric

publication.release_notes: Five focused skills now cover organising, participating, judging, building and publishing a team site. Each provides connector and REST paths. The hosted connector adds participant, judge and organiser actions through one personal connection.
